# restate_cloud_environment (Data Source)

An existing Restate Cloud environment, looked up by ID.

Use it to read the connection metadata of an environment this configuration does not manage -- typically the second stage of a two-stage bootstrap, where the environment was created by a different state.

It exposes no secrets. An environment API key's bearer secret is available only when the key is created, so this data source lists key IDs and nothing more.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read an environment this configuration does not manage -- typically stage 2 of a two-stage
# bootstrap, where the environment was created by a different state.

data "restate_cloud_environment" "production" {
  id = var.environment_id
}

# A data source's result is known at plan time, so this can configure a provider. The API key
# cannot come from here: Restate Cloud returns a key's secret only when the key is created.
provider "restate" {
  alias = "production"

  admin_url           = data.restate_cloud_environment.production.admin_base_url
  environment_api_key = var.restate_environment_api_key
}

variable "environment_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "restate_environment_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Environment ID to look up, for example `env_1a2b3c`.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account the environment was found in: the account the provider is configured for.
- `admin_base_url` (String) Base URL of this environment's Admin API.
- `api_key_ids` (List of String) IDs of the API keys that exist for this environment, including any created outside Terraform. Secrets are not included and cannot be read back.
- `ingress_base_url` (String) Base URL for invoking services in this environment.
- `invocation_metrics_url` (String) URL for this environment's invocation metrics. Empty when the API reports none.
- `name` (String) Environment name.
- `proxy_base_url` (String) Base URL of the proxy service for this environment.
- `region` (String) Region the environment runs in.
- `region_display_name` (String) Human-readable region label. Empty when the API reports none.
- `signing_public_key` (String) Public key services use to verify that a request came from this environment.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status: `PENDING`, `ACTIVE`, `FAILED`, or `DELETED`. Check this before depending on the connection metadata: a `PENDING` environment may not have all of it yet.
- `tier_id` (String) Environment tier. Unlike the resource, this can report `CUSTOM`, since reading a custom-tier environment carries no drift risk.
- `tunnel_base_url` (String) Base URL of the private tunnel service for this environment.
- `tunnel_srv` (String) SRV record the tunnel client resolves to reach this environment.
